function: TD3 agent jointly sets cluster powers, NOMA power coefficients and IRS phase shifts to maximize long-term sum rate under outage-constrained QoS and imperfect CSI (p. 7).
system: Downlink IRS-assisted MISO-NOMA: BS with N=2-4 antennas, 4-8 single-antenna UEs in 2-4 clusters, passive reflecting IRS (M=16), direct link blocked; carrier frequency not stated (p. 4, 12).
method: TD3 (twin-delayed DDPG) actor-critic deep reinforcement learning with two critics and replay buffer; actor with 128-512 neurons per hidden layer; ZF beamforming and user pairing non-learned (p. 7-12).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rician BS-IRS link (factor 1, 50 m), Rayleigh IRS-UE links (UEs 50-100 m), Gaussian cascaded-channel error with lambda=0.01; no public dataset (p. 4, 12).
test_conditions: Fixed channels: new error samples each episode, 1000 test episodes; dynamic: 24 training channel sets, 100 test channels; tests also at larger CSI error and target rates (p. 13-15).
baselines: Learned: DDPG agent; non-learned: SDP-based IRS design with non-robust ZFBF and fixed power (SDP-ZFBF), and random design (p. 12).
metrics: Average system sum rate, training reward convergence, outage and non-outage probability versus CSI error and target rate, PDF of weakest UE rate (p. 13-15).
complexity: Actor inference O(T(Omega*Card(s)+I*Omega^2+...+C*N^2)), about O(Omega^2) for Omega neurons; SUPA O(K^2); contrasted analytically with SOCP-ADMM, SOCP and SDP designs (p. 10-11); no measured runtime.
q1_support: p. 12: "modelled using the Rician fading coefficients" for BS-IRS, with Rayleigh IRS-UE links and path-loss exponents (Eqs. 32-33); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 14: "24 different channel sets are used for training" and p. 15: "a set of 100 channels and 10 error samples per channel are used for testing" are draws of the same simulator; "generalization over larger λ values than the one used for training" (p. 14) is a CSI-error sweep.
q3_support: p. 12: "Baseline 1: a DDPG agent" and "Baseline 2: a convex optimization-based scheme"; p. 13: "The TD3 agent outperforms the benchmark schemes for both C = 2 and C = 3 scenarios" (sum rate, Fig. 7).
q4_support: p. 10: "computational-complexity is written as" O(T(Omega*Card(s)+I*Omega^2+Card(a)*Omega+I*Omega+Card(a)+C*N^2)), reduced to about O(Omega^2); p. 11 gives O(K^2) for the pairing step.
q5_support: p. 12: "all the system parameters used to generate the simulation results" (Table 2) describes its own simulator; the paper gives no code or data link and no public dataset.
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Area 3: learned IRS phase shifts with power allocation; user pairing (SUPA) and ZF beamforming are non-learned. Figs. 9 and 10 mark the training lambda and training rate, so tests at larger lambda or target rates are sweeps of CSI error and QoS threshold. Tables 1-2 and Figs. 6-14 were read as images.
